summary: Audit a 31-folder Box supplier document room through the Box CLI. The agent must enumerate folders/files by ID, download and read document contents, perform the 3 exact file moves, and encode the audit result directly in Box state: exactly one open deficiency task with exact codes/due date plus exactly one QA viewer collaboration for each of 16 non-compliant suppliers, and exactly one shared link for each of 15 compliant suppliers. No report file is graded; the live Box mock state is the sole deliverable.
check_strategy: private/expected_answer.json drives the verifier; it reads the live box_cli state (files/tasks/collaborations/shared_links) over MOCK_SITE_URL/__bench/state. Every supplier folder and mis-shelved document is still validated atomically internally, but the emitted checks are aggregated into distinct capability units (docs/check-granularity.md R1-R7): the binary pass is the AND of grouped atoms, identical to the pre-migration per-atom schema, while checks_total reflects capabilities rather than one template repeated across 16/15/3 inputs. Binary pass requires all checks. The task stresses correct CLI/API state operation (ID-based discovery, download/read workflow, precise create/move/share/collab commands, resume-without-duplicates) plus the per-supplier compliance verdict and deficiency-code reasoning.

checks.description: Environment plumbing: the Box bench state is reachable over the verifier-only endpoint (R2).

Filing judgement: every genuinely mis-shelved document is moved into the folder of the supplier it belongs to and removed from the wrong folder, while the corporate group certificate (belonging to no supplier folder) is left in place. Internally validates the 3 moves + 1 leave-in-place atom.
Non-compliant classification + action: exactly one open Box task exists on a document inside each of the 16 non-compliant supplier folders. Internally validates one atom per non-compliant folder.

Verdict reasoning (the §4 scope/entity/currency core): each non-compliant task message carries exactly the required deficiency code set for that folder, with no extra policy codes, including the double-code expired-own-plus-current-sister edge case. Internally validates one atom per non-compliant folder.
Each of the 16 non-compliant tasks has the required due_at timestamp. Internally validates one atom per non-compliant folder.
Exactly one role=viewer collaboration for the QA reviewer exists on each of the 16 non-compliant supplier folders. Internally validates one atom per non-compliant folder.
Exactly one shared link exists on each of the 15 compliant supplier folders. Internally validates one atom per compliant folder.
Restraint (negative): no non-compliant supplier folder has a shared link. Internally validates one atom per non-compliant folder.
Restraint (negative): no compliant supplier folder has a task or a collaboration. Internally validates one no-task atom and one no-collab atom per compliant folder.
Restraint (negative): no supplier folder has a non-viewer collaboration.

Anti-duplication: exactly 16 supplier-document tasks, exactly 16 QA viewer collaborations, and exactly 15 supplier-folder shared links exist in total. Internally validates the three exact-count atoms.

notes: Total checks = 11 capability units (down from 134 per-atom; deterministic capacity migration 2026-06-09, see docs/capacity-migration-status.md). Each emitted check is the AND of the same per-item atoms the pre-migration schema validated, so all(checks) is bit-for-bit the old binary pass (refold + rerun against the 9-model phoenix0140 release archive: partition 0, refold 0, rerun 0 mismatches). Folding: setup_gate folds mock reachability (R2); documents_filed_correctly folds 3 misfiled_moved + 1 blanket_not_moved (one filing competence, R3+R6); noncompliant_tasks_created / deficiency_codes_correct / task_due_dates_correct / qa_viewer_collabs_created are four distinct non-compliant-workflow capabilities each folding 16 per-folder atoms (R3/R4); compliant_shared_links_created folds 15 atoms (R3); noncompliant_no_shared_link / compliant_no_task_no_collab / no_nonviewer_collab are restraint negatives (R6); exact_action_counts folds the 3 anti-duplication counts (R6). The document-reading judgements are realistic inputs; the benchmark difficulty is the per-supplier compliance verdict, the deficiency-code reasoning, and precise non-duplicated Box CLI state operation.
